description: List the bunkering ports the API carries (UN/LOCODE, name, country, region, major-port flag, fuel services, trading hours), or read one port with its prices collected in the last 24 hours. Use it to resolve a port name to the UN/LOCODE that opa_get_marine_fuel_history needs, or to check which fuel services a port lists. Works with any valid API key; the API applies its own marine per-minute rate limit. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

country.description: List filter: country as the API reports it, e.g. 'Singapore', 'United States'

major_only.description: List filter: only ports the API flags as major

port.description: One port by UN/LOCODE or name, e.g. 'SGSIN' or 'Singapore'. Omit to list ports.

region.description: List filter: region as the API reports it, e.g. 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Americas', 'Middle East'

name: opa_get_marine_ports
title: Get Marine Fuel Ports
